channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Keyonte George | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Keyonte George from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Austin Ainge on Keyonte George
item.description:
Austin Ainge:

“Leadership is different. Sometimes we have a narrow definition, andKeyonte George is a really happy, nice person. He gets along with everybody and he shows up for everybody. He's maybe not a screamer and a yeller type of guy, he's not a taskmaster, he's still very young learning his own way in the league, but he shows up for everybody, he is there for everybody,he is smile and work ethic every day. That's his way of leading and that's awesome.”

Austin Ainge on Keyonte George, Sep 19, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Darryn Peterson on Keyonte George
item.description:
[KUTV2news]Darryn Peterson:

“I think me and Keyonte are going to be one of the best backcourts in the NBA…andwhat fans should know about me? I’m a cool guy, approachable. Want a pic or autograph or anything just come say what’s up!”

Darryn Peterson on Keyonte George, Jun 24, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Keyonte George
item.description:
“I want to highlight the Jazz. They came in there and outplayed us. It started with Keyonte George, who deserves to be an All-Star,”

Donovan Mitchell on Keyonte George, Jan 13, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Will Hardy on Keyonte George
item.description:
Ryan Miller:Will Hardy on Keyonte George:

“Tonight was sort of his coming out party in terms of being an off-the-dribble 3-point shooter. I think we saw tonight what I've been seeing and we've been seeing behind closed doors.”

Will Hardy on Keyonte George, Feb 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @millerjryan.
